name: The Archaeological Ensemble of 17th Century Port Royal
description: Port Royal sits at the tip of the Palisadoes sandspit, guarding the entrance to Kingston Harbour in southeastern Jamaica. In the 1600s it was a booming English port, famed for pirates and privateers, until an earthquake in 1692 dropped much of the town beneath the sea. Today you can explore the surviving fortifications on land, while submerged streets and buildings remain preserved offshore.
